text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Hosted API (us-east-1) alert: sustained queue growth detected. queue_depth=22,480 (+12000 in 8m), p95=6.3s -> 13.7s, p99=21s -> 46s, errors(502/timeout)=6.8%. Autoscaler reporting repeated node create failures and provider rate limits. Paging maya_oncall.

maya_oncall: ack. I'm taking this. quick ask: is this localized to a model class or system-wide?

sam_infra: mostly affects text-generation GPU-backed routes (longer-context chat/completions). From logs: lots of create_node failures with both QuotaExceeded and CreateRateLimit errors from cloud API. Also saw a bunch of identical payloads replaying from a handful of API keys + some traffic from an IP cluster. Snippet: 

sam_infra: ```
2026-03-15T05:10:03Z autoscaler ERROR create_node: QuotaExceeded: GPU quota v4/limit=0
2026-03-15T05:10:09Z autoscaler ERROR create_node: CreateRateLimitExceeded: too many create requests
2026-03-15T05:10:15Z autoscaler WARN backoff increased to 16s
```

jasper_prod: customer-impact check: a dozen high-volume non-enterprise keys are getting timeouts; three enterprise tenants on pinned nodes are fine. CS, prep notices for impacted customers and list the recommended workarounds (cpu fallback endpoint, retry with jitter).

cs_lead: drafting now. will include note about ongoing mitigation and estimated next update in 20m.

maya_oncall: immediate mitigations I'd like: 1) failover best-effort traffic to us-west-2 if possible 2) flip non-sla routing to cpu-quantized endpoints 3) start per-key emergency throttles for the loudest keys 4) open cloud support escalation for quota bump 5) hold autoscaler creates for 60s then resume with backoff. Who can do region failover?

se_team: I can flip routing and do a regional failover policy. downside: cross-region adds latency but preferable to timeouts. Suggest failover logic: route selector "customer_tier!=enterprise" -> prefer us-west-2 cpu-quantized. Keep enterprise pinned in us-east-1.

security-bot: flagged 2 API keys with suspicious high-volume patterns consistent with credential stuffing. Recommend immediate rotation / temp-suspend.

sam_infra: applying key throttles and temp-suspending the two suspicious keys now. Also adding an edge IP block for a small CIDR cluster. Starting throttle script: `/ops/limits/rapid-throttle --keys=8 --region=us-east-1`.

se_team: executing routing flip: 

se_team: ```bash
# promote cpu fallback + cross-region preference for non-sla
http POST https://internal-routes/api/v1/switch -d '{"from_region":"us-east-1","to_region":"us-west-2","selector":"tier!=enterprise","strategy":"prefer_cpu_quantized"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```

deploy-bot: @se_team started routing-change job rc-4455. rollout: 25% -> 60% -> 100%.

se_team: routing-change complete. note: we injected a header X-Redwood-Degraded: true for routed calls.

sam_infra: queue depth started to stabilize: 22,480 -> 15,300 after throttle+routing -> 8,200 after cross-region ramp. p95 for cpu-routed traffic down to 2.4s, GPU pending queue still showing heavy tail.

ana_sre: (ana_sre): opened cloud support ticket TKT-55421. Provider acknowledges quota shortfall and reports they can issue emergency quota but creation rate limits persist; they recommend serialized create attempts and a small warm pool. They estimate 25-40m for quota to be effective.

maya_oncall: while we wait for quota, can we bring up capacity using our dedicated/reserved pool in the other account or region? Any spare dedicated capacity we can borrow?

sam_infra: we have a small dedicated hot-pool for Dedicated customers in us-east-1 but it's reserved. We can temporarily borrow 20 nodes from the hot-pool for hosted best-effort if ops approves. raising request to steward. Also, starting a manual provisioner job to attempt creating ephemeral nodes in us-west-2 where quota is free for us.

jasper_prod: approve borrowing 15 nodes from dedicated hot-pool for 30 minutes to mitigate customer impact (ops sign-off noted). Please track cost and notify finance.

sam_infra: initiating hot-pool borrow and manual prov kick: `/ops/provisioner/kick --region=us-east-1 --count=15 --use-hotpool`

deploy-bot: provisioner job prov-9988 started: creating 15 nodes (hot-pool promotion). Progress: 0/15 -> 15/15 :white_check_mark:

sam_infra: hot-pool nodes promoted, joined cluster. autoscaler still careful on cloud creates but augmented cluster capacity. Immediate queue drop: 8,200 -> 2,100 in 7m. p99 latency falling.

security-bot: confirmed two compromised keys rotated and sessions invalidated. user-reported anomalies flagged.

maya_oncall: excellent. keep throttles in place for another hour and maintain cross-region degrade until metrics stable. CS, send update to the affected customers with ETA and suggested workarounds.

cs_lead: sending update now. will include reference to using cpu-quantized endpoints and note the hot-pool migration to reduce impact.

sam_infra: cloud support update: provisional quota increase applied to us-east-1; provider warns create rate throttles will be eased gradually. We've added a create-rate backoff to autoscaler (2/s max, exponential backoff on 429). Patch applied: 

sam_infra: ```bash
kubectl -n infra patch autoscaler hosted-gpu --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/createRateLimit","value":2},{"op":"add","path":"/spec/createBackoff","value":"exp"}]'
```

sam_infra: after provider quota, we resumed controlled creates and initiated a small burst (20 nodes) in us-east-1 with serialized creates. Provisioner job prov-9989: 20/20 nodes joined.

deploy-bot: prov-9989 progress: 0/20 -> 20/20 :white_check_mark:

sam_infra: combined actions (routing, throttles, hot-pool, quota bump) drained queue to <400 within 10 minutes of node join. p95/p99 returning toward baseline. timeouts dropping significantly.

ana_sre: opened follow-ups: 1) soft warm standby GPU pool of 50 reserved cores (ops config) 2) pre-approved emergency quota plan with cloud provider 3) autoscaler change: serialize create calls + smarter backoff on 429/Quota errors 4) ingress circuit-breaker to auto-throttle noisy keys and auto-rotate compromised keys 5) cross-region failover playbook addition. Assign follow-ups to sam_infra + jasper_prod + se_team.

maya_oncall: incident status: mitigated. keep monitoring for 90m and then close if stable. schedule postmortem: include timeline, root cause (external spike + insufficient warm capacity + provider create-rate constraints), mitigations performed (routing, cross-region fallback, hot-pool borrow, key rotation, serialized creates), and action items above.

cs_lead: one customer reported a failed nightly batch that will need retry; CS to coordinate compensation.

maya_oncall: noted for postmortem. also add security incident coordination for compromised keys.

sam_infra: adding metric alarms: new rule for sustained queue growth >2x baseline for 5m triggers auto-degrade routing; new alert for create_node failure rate >3/min triggers pause-and-backoff.

se_team: will implement a per-key circuit breaker prototype to auto-throttle keys exceeding 4x baseline and optionally require rotation.

deploy-bot: incident thread status updated by maya_oncall -> mitigated -> monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, impacted_customers=11 (notified), duration_so_far=62m, followups=[sam_infra,jasper_prod,se_team,ana_sre].

maya_oncall: thanks all. great response. I'll host a 1hr postmortem review tomorrow and publish notes. leaving thread open for follow-up until end of monitoring window. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
